resources.string: Swipe the words or sentences shown; the gestures are saved on this phone only

Swipe what is shown below into the field, the way you normally swipe. The gestures are saved only on this phone, in the folder shown at the bottom, and are never uploaded. Nothing you type outside this screen is recorded.
Swipe as fast as you can, without aiming carefully.
Swipe the sentence word by word. Fix a wrong word the way you normally would (suggestion strip or a new swipe), then press Enter or Next sentence.
%1$d recorded this session · %2$d in all files
The files stay in this folder on the phone (the app has no internet access). Copy them to a computer with:
Saves your swipes on this phone only, so that swipe typing can be measured and improved. Never in password fields or in incognito mode. You can view, delete and export them below.
View, delete or export what was recorded while typing
This is everything that is stored about your typing: each swiped word, the words before it and what you did next. Newest first. It stays on this phone and is not part of any backup.
Recording stops at %1$d swipes or %2$d MB, whichever comes first.
The limit is reached. Nothing more is recorded until you delete the data.

Swipes in the file: %1$d. The file contains the words you swiped, the words before each of them (%2$d at most), the touch coordinates and timing of each gesture, the keyboard layout and language, and the words the keyboard offered. It contains no app names and nothing else from the fields you typed in. Droneboard sends it nowhere; you choose where the file is saved.
The file could not be saved
Delete all recorded swipes (%1$d)? This cannot be undone.
